abilities.name: Chop
abilities.description: A basic melee attack dealing moderate physical damage.

abilities.name: Cleave
abilities.description: A melee attack dealing moderate physical damage and staggering the target.

abilities.name: Clobber
abilities.description: The minotaur performs a strong overhead swing with its cleaver, dealing high physical damage and stunning its target. This can be blocked to stagger the minotaur instead.

abilities.name: Flying Leap
abilities.description: If the target is far away, the minotaur throws its cleaver at them and leaps over to pick it up, indicated by a red circle, dealing moderate physical damage.

abilities.name: Ram
abilities.description: The minotaur charges forward, indicated by a red circle around them, dealing high physical damage and knocking down targets.

abilities.name: Elemental Weapon
abilities.description: The minotaur slams its weapon on the ground, heating it up and making it glow. This buff lasts for about 30 seconds.

abilities.name: Elemental Pool
abilities.description: When Elemental Weapon is active, all attacks done will leave behind a pool of fire, indicated by a red circle, dealing continuous low flame damage.

abilities.name: Flame Cross
abilities.description: When Elemental Weapon is active, the minotaur gains an ability where it swings its flaming cleaver across the ground, sending three flaming swirls forward close together as indicated by red circles, each dealing moderate flame damage each and staggering.

notes: Minotaurs were first added to the game with Update 10, with the Dark Brotherhood DLC.

Minotaur Shamans found in various locations such as Knightsgrave and throughout Northern Elsweyr are simply called "Minotaur" and have the same health as the warriors instead of their usually slightly weaker health.
A minotaur polymorph is available for players to wear, allowing them to take on the form of a minotaur.
Minotaurs in the Illumination Academy Stacks appear as spiris.

summary: This article is about the creature. For the polymorph, see Minotaur (polymorph). Minotaurs are a race of bull-like humanoids found on the Gold Coast and in Northern Elsweyr. They tend to congregate at ancient First Era ruins. Although usually considered to be nothing more than beasts, minotaurs possess rudimentary equipment and some shamans have the ability to use magic. Minotaurs have a chance to drop Oxblood Fungus Spores. In Horns of the Reach, Minotaurs have allied with Reachmen to attack the people of Falkreath. In Northern Elsweyr, Minotaurs can often be seen clashing with gryphons. For more information, see the main lore article.
